marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind south 20 knots increasing to northwest 30 Saturday
morning. Periods of rain Saturday late in the day. Fog patches
forming late overnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less Saturday morning then
building to 1 to 2 Saturday afternoon. Seas building to 2 to 3 Saturday
evening.<br/>
